about: Patch timeline of City of Heroes from the Issue 24 beta to Homecoming Issue 28, catalogued from homecoming.wiki patch notes (summarised, not copied). 'planner' lists changes to data a build planner reads; 'markers' lists facts that tell a client of that patch apart from the one before. See docs/patch-history.md.

patches.label: 12.08.08 Build 2400.20120806XXXX.X (Initial Beta Release)
planner: New Blaster secondary set Martial Combat (melee/ranged, mixes Martial Arts, Ninjitsu, Time Manipulation); includes the power Reaction Time (named in the third beta notes).
New Dominator secondary set Martial Assault (melee/ranged, Martial Arts plus Ninjitsu shuriken attacks).
Power pool, epic pool and patron pool powers become customizable; Minimal FX variants added for Shark Skin, Scorpion Shield, Oppressive Gloom, Dark Embrace.
All non-travel pools gain a 5th power, trainable at level 14 with any two other pool powers owned.
Presence: Challenge replaced by Pacify (single-target Placate, no Taunt enhancements). Intimidate cost 10 end, mag 3 fear plus 30% chance of extra mag 1. Invoke Panic cost 18 end, mag 3, acc 0.9x.
Presence gets 5th power Unrelenting: 30s boost to damage, attack speed and recovery, unenhanceable heal over time.
Fighting pool gets 5th power Cross Punch; Boxing, Kick, Cross Punch and Brawl gain synergy bonuses depending on how many Fighting attacks are owned.
Medicine: Stimulant replaced by Injection (usable on allies and foes, foe debuff of speed, to-hit, damage; range 40ft; no Interrupt Time enhancements).
Medicine gets 5th power Field Medic; owning it removes Aid Other interrupt and adds an endurance gain effect to Aid Self.
Concealment gets 5th power Misdirection (PBAoE placate, up to 10 targets, resistance debuff).
Leadership gets 5th power Victory Rush (recovery and end-reduction team buff after a foe is defeated; recharge not enhanceable).

Blaster secondaries each get a 'sustain' power pickable by level 20; renamed: Touch of Fear -> Touch of the Beyond (Darkness Manipulation, 80ft), Blazing Aura -> Cauterizing Aura, Chilling Embrace -> Frigid Protection, Cloaking Device -> Field Operative, Lightning Clap -> Force of Thunder, Conserve Power -> Energize.
Sustain powers cost little or no endurance; Mental Manipulation already had Drain Psyche so is unchanged.

Ranged blast tier 9 nukes (Blackstar, Thunderous Blast, Nova, Inferno, Psychic Wail, Atomic Blast, Dreadful Wail, Blizzard): recharge cut to 145-170s, damage scale ~4, no endurance crash, cost ~27.73 end.
Overcharge recharge 180s -> 125s; Geyser 205s -> 125s; Hail of Bullets 120s -> 105s. Full Auto and Rain of Arrows left alone.
All Snipe powers become instant and uninterruptible when user has at least 22% bonus To Hit.
Strong single-target 'tier 3' blasts have range raised from 40/50ft to 80ft.
Touch of Fear/Scare terrorize changes: scaling table removed; Touch of Fear gets 30% chance of 7s mag 1 crit fear in PvE (Blaster, Brute, Scrapper, Stalker, Tanker).
Power Boost, Build Up and similar effects now also strengthen Absorb; Cardiac and Resilient Alpha swap Intangible Duration for Absorb strength; Clarion Destiny +Special boosts Absorb.
Defender and Corruptor pseudo-pet blast damage (Burn, Ice Storm, Blizzard, Rain of Fire, Rain of Arrows) re-based to own AT damage mods; Corruptor nuke scourge raised to 50% for most sets.
Dual Pistols: Pistols applies ammo-type DoT/slow/debuff; Empty Clips, Bullet Rain, Executioner's Shot cast times cut to 1.67s.
Spines: Barb Swipe cast 0.83s, recharge 3s, end 4.368, damage scale 0.84; Lunge recharge 6s, end 6.864, scale 1.32.
Origin ranged powers (Apprentice Charm, Taser Dart, Tranq Dart, Throwing Knives, Mutagen) get extra accuracy and damage until level 15.
Four new Lore sets: Banished Pantheon, The Tsoo, Knives of Vengeance, Talons of Vengeance; all Lore pets lose endurance cost; many existing Lore pet powers rebalanced.

Four new rare IO sets, level 20-50: Annihilation (Targeted AoE, resist debuff proc), Unbreakable Guard (Resist Damage, +7.5% max HP), Reactive Defenses (Defense, resist scaling with lost HP), Preventive Medicine (Healing, absorb proc).
Invention procs converted from flat percent chance to Procs Per Minute for many sets; PPM chance capped at 90% maximum; PvP damage procs now deal more damage instead of higher chance.
PPM values set per enhancement, e.g. 3.5 for most damage procs, 4.5 for former 33% procs (Hecatomb, Apocalypse, Armageddon), 1 for Decimation Build Up and Gaussian's.
Store-bought versions of many procs raised to match crafted PPM (e.g. 3 -> 3.5); Ragnarok store version 3.5 PPM, Armageddon crafted 5 PPM.
Set bonuses reworked: XP debt reduction bonuses removed; single mez resistances replaced by paired damage resist plus mez resist bonuses (e.g. Fire/Cold/Mez); all damage resistance bonuses increased.
New set bonus type introduced: Endurance Discount.

Dozens of IO sets get individual bonus changes (Bonesnap, Touch of Death, Crushing Impact, Salvo, Tempest, Detonation, Positron's Blast, Ragnarok, MultiStrike, Armageddon, Executioner's Contract, etc.).
Mission Architect custom enemies can use Time Manipulation, Beam Rifle, Street Justice, Titan Weapons, Darkness Control, Staff Fighting, Beast Mastery.

patches.label: 12.08.14 Beta Build 2400.201208122118.08
planner: Concealment/Misdirection duration fixed at a constant 15 seconds, no level scaling.
Blaster sustain toggles (Cauterizing Aura, Frigid Protection, Reaction Time, Field Operative) all recharge in 10 seconds and stay toggled when mezzed, with offence suppressed.
Martial Combat Defiance values corrected (wrong Area Factor lookups).
Martial Assault: Shuriken Throw, Caltrops, Explosive Shuriken endurance cost lowered; Ki Push no longer autohit.
Preventive Medicine proc: 10% chance at 31-75% health, 100% below 31%, internal cooldown 120s -> 90s.
Scourging Blast recharge proc gains a small AoE heal.
Improved Movement Bonus global set bonuses +50%; Running, Flying and Leaping set bonuses swapped with global Improved Movement Bonus.

Mez resistance part of many set bonuses reduced (about 3%/5% pairs lowered to 1.5%/2.5% or 2.25%/3.75%), across roughly 35 sets incl. Crushing Impact, Salvo, Annihilation, Unbreakable Guard, Celerity.
Reactive Armor 2 and 3 piece bonuses corrected; Fury of the Gladiator 2 slot PvE bonus changed to 3.75% Fire/Cold, 6.25% Mez.
Disorient-bonus procs (Executioner's Contract, Pounding Slugfest, Debilitative Action, Razzle Dazzle, Unspeakable Terror, Triumphant Insult) now trigger mez suppression in PvP.

Epic AT nukes standardised: Dawn Strike, Quasar, Widow Psychic Wail recharge 360s -> 145s, scale 4 damage, ~27.7 end, no crash.
Fighting/Cross Punch debuffs no longer scale with level difference.
No endurance discount enhancements accepted by Cauterizing Aura, Field Operative, Frigid Protection, Reaction Time (no endurance cost).

Leadership/Victory Rush now benefits from endurance modification enhancements and sets; Pacify no longer listed as accepting Taunt sets.
Medicine/Injection now accepts Accuracy and Slow enhancements plus To Hit Debuff, Accurate To Hit Debuff and Slow sets.
Second resistance pass on IO set bonuses: many sets get 2-6 slot resist bonuses raised or lowered; Mako's Bite 2 slot changed to Toxic/Psionic/Mez.
Preventive Medicine, Reactive Defenses and others get adjusted health and endurance discount bonuses; Exploit Weakness, Calibrated Accuracy, Executioner's Contract defense bonuses raised.
Spider's Bite global Toxic proc fixed; Scourging Blast description now mentions +Health chance.

patches.label: Issue 25 client launch (consolidated notes to 2014-01-19)
planner: New archetype: Sentinel (ranged damage with moderate protection and control protection).
Sentinel inherent Scrutiny: target takes extra 10% damage and is easier to hit; opportunities/vulnerabilities up to 30% extra damage; meter-based.
Sentinel vulnerabilities/opportunities last 15s (was 8s); attack resistance debuff 10s (was 5s); opportunity damage doubled.
Sentinel defensive opportunities heal once per attack, based on cast time.
New power sets listed in highlights: Atomic Manipulation, Ninja Training, Radiation Armor, Radiation Melee, Radioactive Assault, Tactical Arrow, Temporal Manipulation.
Power set proliferation across archetypes (details not listed in the consolidated notes).
New Judgement power Mighty Judgement: PBAoE smashing; Core tree more damage, Radial tree high-magnitude knockup.
Rebalanced Incarnate system: all enemies drop Incarnate XP and Threads; Incarnate Merits always Empyrean.
Veteran levels: level 50 earns Veteran Levels per 5 million XP, to 99, giving Empyrean Merits, respecs and Incarnate Threads.
Task forces, strike forces and trials (non-Incarnate) can start at any team size, including solo.
Dr. Quaterfield Task Force exemplars to 45 instead of 44, keeping Incarnate powers.
Enhancement Catalyst turns any Invention Set IO of any level into its Attuned version; Attuned IOs mix with crafted for bonuses.
Superior Attuned IOs have higher set bonuses and do not keep bonuses when mixed with non-Superior set IOs.
Attuned IOs (ATOs and Winter sets included) become tradable on the Auction House; no longer account bound.
New Knockback IO set: Sudden Acceleration.
Intangibility enhancements retired; remaining powers that took them no longer accept them.
Enhancement Boosters, Catalysts, Converters, Unslotters tradable; boosted or combined enhancements can be traded or emailed keeping boosts.

Proc rework: Absolute Amazement, Achilles' Heel, Annihilation, Basilisk's Gaze, Bruising (Tankers), Dark Watcher's Despair, Dominion of Arachnos, Fury of the Gladiator, Induced Coma, Pacing of the Turtle, Winter's Bite no longer use GrantPower hacks.
Those procs now use linked chance mods and caster stacking: they stack, extend duration, and obey combat mods (level difference).
Proc 8% (attuned) and 12% (superior) resistance debuffs share a stack key; the larger overwrites the smaller.
Dynamic-damage procs (Offensive Adaptation, Plant Manipulation Toxins, Hybrid Double Hit) evaluated separately in auras and pseudo pets.
Bio Armor Defensive Adaptation heal procs: one heal per attack, cast-time based, no level-dependent loss.
Shield Wall proc no longer affected by damage buffs.
Hamidon, Titan and Hydra enhancement drops use new weighted table (Damage/Accuracy x8, etc.).
Enhancement Catalyst drop rate x10 from all critters; Merit vendor sells Catalysts, Boosters, Converters, Unslotters, set recipes at reduced Merit costs.
Stores list only enhancements usable by origin within a level range by default.
Currency consolidation: Hero, Villain, Astral, Empyrean, Vanguard Merits convertible to Reward Merits; Prestige removed from bases.
Tanker Ice Melee fixes: Frost DoT accelerated, Frozen Fists two damage ticks, Freezing Touch damage increased.
Blaster Ninja Training Kuji-In Toh recharge 200s, lasts 210s.
Blaster Temporal Manipulation Time Wall accepts Immobilize duration enhancements and set IOs.
Dual Pistols costume-slot fix lets Ninja Training work as a Blaster secondary.
Controller Force Fields Repulsion Bomb does containment damage.
Day job powers normalised (10 days pre-badge, 7 days post-badge/accolade, max 30 charges); Jet Pack max duration 2 hours.
Spider's Bite Toxic chance no longer affects caster or friendly targets.
Tanker Super Reflexes Evasion taunt duration corrected.

Set-acceptance fixes: Darkness Manipulation Touch of the Beyond takes ToHit Debuff sets; Devices Web Grenade takes Speed Debuff sets; Electricity Manipulation Force of Thunder takes Healing sets; Mastermind Cold Domination takes IO sets; Sentinel Sonic Attack takes Universal sets.

Mez-protection click powers (Power Surge, Overload, Hybernate, Icy Bastion, Unstoppable, Moment of Glory, Active Defense, Kuji-In Rin, Kuji-In Retsu, Practiced Brawler, Elude, Rune of Protection) usable while mezzed.

Ninja Training Immobilizing Dart, Plant Manipulation Entangle, Temporal Manipulation Time Wall usable while mezzed; Wild Fortress, Temporal Healing, Sentinel Willpower Up To The Challenge no longer drop when mezzed.
Martial Combat: Throw Sand recharge 90s, magnitude 3.
Atomic Manipulation fixes: Positron Cell as damage over time; Beta Decay accepts Accurate ToHit Debuff IOs; Radioactive Cloud accepts Accuracy.
Fire Manipulation: Burn does damage in PvP; Lightning Rod usable while flying. Defiance duration formulas fixed.
Brute Mercurial Blow no longer applies Bruising.
Sentinel Psy Blast: Will Domination accepts Sleep enhancements and generic IOs; Psionic Strike no longer accepts them.
Stalker Fiery Melee and Ice Melee affected by Assassin's Mark ATO proc.
Pet changes: all ATs can rename pets; combat attributes visible for any pet.
Dual and Team Inspirations drop and are tradable; large drop-rate and vendor price changes for inspirations and recipes.
